probes.title: Temporal dynamics of microbial rhodopsin fluorescence reports absolute membrane voltage.
probes.answer: Membrane voltage is a fundamentally important property of a living cell; its value is tightly coupled to membrane transport, the dynamics of transmembrane proteins, and to intercellular communication.
